quests.title: The First Harvest
quests.description: An old gardener left notes near the cottage. Lumeria's soil is patient and kind.

steps.text: Read the gardener's note near the cottage
Make a watering can and a garden plot at the workbench
Place the plot on your homestead (B) and plant seeds

hints: Crops grow one step for every day they were watered. They never wilt, so there is no hurry at all.

quests.title: The Forgotten Garden
quests.description: Somewhere in Firefly Grove, old hedges hide a garden nobody has visited in years.

steps.text: Revive the withered plant with your watering can

hints: The hedges are west of the grove's waystone. Only the withered plant's gap leads inside.

quests.title: The Old Whiskers
quests.description: Fishers whisper about a very old, very gentle catfish near the creek bridge.

steps.text: Read the fisher's notes by the creek
Make a fishing rod at a workbench
Catch your first fish at any ripples
Catch five different kinds of fish
Meet Old Whiskers at the creek bridge

hints: Different fish swim in the creek, the ponds and the sea. Some only come out at night or in the rain.
